intro: Exact-answer evaluation often ignores harmless differences in case and spacing. Normalizing both predictions and references creates a symmetric comparison rule.
task: Normalize casefolded whitespace and compare against multiple accepted answers.
requirements: Normalize each string by casefolding, splitting on Unicode whitespace, and joining with one space. Return a bool indicating whether normalized answer equals any normalized accepted string. Punctuation is significant; an empty accepted list never matches.
Sequence inputs are Python lists or tuples of at most 1000 items. Text inputs contain valid Unicode scalar characters and at most 10000 characters.
Return the documented Python output types and preserve all caller inputs. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs unless the task explicitly reports a record-level rejection.

hints.title: Trace one record
hints.body: Apply exactly the same normalization to both sides.

hints.title: Handle the boundary
hints.body: Casefold is intended for caseless comparison and can expand some characters.

explanation: Exact-answer evaluation often ignores harmless differences in case and spacing. Normalizing both predictions and references creates a symmetric comparison rule.
Punctuation remains meaningful under this policy. Removing it would make a broader equivalence relation and could accept answers the task considers different.
